laws.rule: Tokoname City (home of Chubu Centrair airport) accommodation tax: JPY 200 a person a night (about A$1.80, RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82) at hotels, ryokan, simple lodgings and minpaku, collected by the lodging; no exemptions are listed. The ministry's consent notice gives the start as 6 January 2025.

laws.rule: Nagoya City bans smoking on roads (carriageway and footpath) in four street no-smoking districts: around Nagoya Station, Sakae, Kanayama and Fujigaoka. This covers walking, cycling and standing still, and holding a lit cigarette. City staff collect a JPY 2,000 fine (about A$18.05, RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82) on the spot or by payment slip. Elsewhere in the city people are asked not to smoke while walking or cycling in public places.
